text_block_list.text:
Three days from now, I will ask each of you
for your reasoning again.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I would like you to provide a concrete
example of your plan to me
then.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The next day, I'm lost in thought, trying to
figure out how best to
approach the
question Симболи Рудольф posed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, now... We meet again. Is the
opposite seat taken?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. The cafeteria's starting to fill
up, and I don't want to take
up a table by
myself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
My apologies if I'm prying, but... You seem
troubled.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list:
I was actually thinking about what you said
yesterday.

text_block_list.text:
Ah, I had a sneaking suspicion you might
be. It seems I've placed a
burden upon
your shoulders.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It might not be my place to say this, but
try not to overthink it.
There's a time to
reflect, and a time to rest.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Let's see. While you're here, why not
nourish the mind with something
sweet?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The natural sugars in fruits, vegetables,
and grains help the brain to
function, and
can enhance your concentration.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If I were to recommend something from
today's menu, I would say the
seasonal
fruit salad is your best bet.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Oh... I suppose I'm preaching to the choir,
aren't I? You are a
professional trainer,
after all.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I didn't mean to lecture you. I'm afraid my
mind tends to get lost in
details.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: You really think everything through, huh?

text_block_list.text:
Of course. Proper nutrition is vital to
maintaining peak physical and
mental
well-being.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Choosing the optimal meal for your current
condition is quite an
important
consideration.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Naturally, this applies to things other than
food as well. Every aspect
of one's daily
life must be contemplated mindfully.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's key to think of the broader
perspective—how each small decision
is an
invaluable step toward the top.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's really nothing special. I'm not
used to being complimented
on my diet
choices.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I was taught to think strategically, ever
since I was little. It's become
so ingrained
in me, there's no fixing it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But, well... I suppose that's part of the
problem.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф's eyes flick to another part
of the cafeteria. I follow
her gaze.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Y-yikes... It sounds like the president's
having a super-serious talk
with that
trainer...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Let's go sit somewhere else. We don't want
to interrupt them with our
chatter!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
...You see what I mean? I sat with you to
avoid taking that empty
table, but the
students still won't sit at it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
A student council president should be
approachable—someone they
can look to
for advice. A leader they can trust to
guide them...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
However, it seems I tend to intimidate my
peers instead, what with
how stiff my
conversations tend to become.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If only I were capable of more casual and
engaging conversation, I
could be more
approachable...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: How about we try a practice conversation now?

text_block_list.text: Practice? You mean, with you?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Hahaha!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Oh, my apologies. It's just... How do I put
it? You're really going the
extra mile for
me. I wasn't expecting such a kind offer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: All right, why not? Let's give it a try.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Could you start us off with a topic?
Anything will do—choose
whatever you
feel most comfortable with.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: What are your hobbies, aside from running?

text_block_list.text:
Hobbies, is it? That's certainly a good
warm-up topic.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I think I would have to say chess. It's fun to
play, of course, but it's
equally
thought-provoking to analyze past score
sheets.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Reading the board, predicting the
opponent's moves, planning each
action to
advance a bigger goal... You could even
say chess is a
microcosm of our lives—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Wait. That was not at all a casual
conversation, was it?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I know Rome wasn't built in a day,
but this is more challenging
than I thought.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me! I've actually been
researching other ways to
enhance small
talk!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Namely in the form of jokes. Some witty
repartee to lighten up a room
and put
people at ease!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: Okay! Hit me with your best shot!

text_block_list.text: Very well. Here goes!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The other day, I was walking down the
street when I saw a dog with
so marvelous
a coat that I couldn't help but exclaim,
"My, that coat
is...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: —paws-itively wonderful!"
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Well? What do you think?!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
This... is a side of Симболи Рудольф I didn't
expect. I feel like I've
gained some insight
into who she is as a person.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hrm... "paws-itively wonderful..." I thought that was pretty clever...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
